sections.heading: MINOR IN PSYCHOLOGY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 from Psychology 1000, Psychology 1000W/X, Psychology 1002A/B and Psychology 1003A/B, or Psychology 1010A/B and Psychology 1015A/B with a mark of at least 60%.
4.0 courses in Psychology courses at the 2000 level or above.
